# Custom function to format the ICC results for pretty printing
format_icc <- function(icc_result) {
  output <- capture.output(print(icc_result))
  output <- output[!grepl("^##", output)]
  cat(paste(output, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
}

# Custom function to format the Pearson Correlation Coefficient Test
format_cor_test <- function(cor_test_obj) {
  
  # Check if the input is of class "htest"
  if(!inherits(cor_test_obj, "htest")) stop("The input object should be of class 'htest'")
  
  # Extract relevant values from correlation test object
  t_value <- cor_test_obj$statistic
  df <- cor_test_obj$parameter
  p_value <- cor_test_obj$p.value
  conf_low <- cor_test_obj$conf.int[1]
  conf_high <- cor_test_obj$conf.int[2]
  correlation <- cor_test_obj$estimate
  
  # Handle very small p-values
  if(p_value < .Machine$double.eps) {
    p_string <- "< 2.2e-16"
  } else {
    p_string <- sprintf("%.6f", p_value)
  }
  
  # Format the results into a string for RMarkdown
  result_string <- sprintf(
    "t = %.3f, df = %.2f, p-value = %s  \n95\\%% confidence interval: [%.3f, %.3f]  \nSample estimate:  \nCorrelation (r) = %.3f",
    t_value, df, p_string, conf_low, conf_high, correlation
  )
  
  return(result_string)
}

# Custom function to format the Paired T Test results for pretty printing
format_ttest <- function(ttest_obj) {
  
  # Check if the input is of class "htest"
  if(!inherits(ttest_obj, "htest")) stop("The input object should be of class 'htest'")
  
  # Extract relevant values from t-test object
  t_value <- ttest_obj$statistic
  df <- ttest_obj$parameter
  p_value <- ttest_obj$p.value
  conf_low <- ttest_obj$conf.int[1]
  conf_high <- ttest_obj$conf.int[2]
  mean_diff <- mean(ttest_obj$estimate)
  
  # Format the results into a string for RMarkdown
  result_string <- sprintf(
    "t = %.3f, df = %.2f, p-value = %.6f  \n95\\%% confidence interval: [%.3f, %.3f]  \nSample estimates: Mean difference = %.3f",
    t_value, df, p_value, conf_low, conf_high, mean_diff
  )
  
  return(result_string)
}

# Custom function to format the Unpaired T Test results for pretty printing
format_unpaired_ttest <- function(ttest_obj) {
  
  # Check if the input is of class "htest"
  if(!inherits(ttest_obj, "htest")) stop("The input object should be of class 'htest'")
  
  # Extract relevant values
  t_value <- ttest_obj$statistic
  df <- ttest_obj$parameter
  p_value <- ttest_obj$p.value
  conf_low <- ttest_obj$conf.int[1]
  conf_high <- ttest_obj$conf.int[2]
  mean_x <- ttest_obj$estimate[1]
  mean_y <- ttest_obj$estimate[2]
  
  # Format the results into a string for RMarkdown
  result_string <- sprintf(
    "t = %.3f, df = %.2f, p-value = %.6f  \n95\\%% confidence interval: [%.3f, %.3f]  \nSample estimates:  \nMean of x = %.3f, Mean of y = %.3f",
    t_value, df, p_value, conf_low, conf_high, mean_x, mean_y
  )
  
  return(result_string)
}

# Custom function to format the Passing-Bablok results for pretty printing
format_pb <- function(ttest_obj, input_names) {
  
  # Extract relevant values from t-test object
  pb_intercept <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Intercept", "Estimate"]
  pb_intercept_lci <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Intercept", "2.5%CI"]
  pb_intercept_uci <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Intercept", "97.5%CI"]
  pb_slope <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Slope", "Estimate"]
  pb_slope_lci <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Slope", "2.5%CI"]
  pb_slope_uci <- ttest_obj$coefficients["Slope", "97.5%CI"]
  
  # Format the results into a string for RMarkdown
  result_string <- sprintf(
    "%s = %.2f [%.2f to %.2f] %s + %.2f [%.2f to %.2f]",
    input_names[[2]], pb_slope, pb_slope_lci, pb_slope_uci, 
    input_names[[1]], pb_intercept, pb_intercept_lci, pb_intercept_uci
  )
  
  return(result_string)
}

# Custom function to format the Shapiro-Wilk results for pretty printing
format_shapiro <- function(shapiro_result) {
  output <- capture.output(print(shapiro_result))
  output <- output[grepl("^W", output)] # Keep only the line that starts with "W"
  cat(paste(output, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
}

# Custom function to format the D’Agostino-Pearson results for pretty printing
format_agostino <- function(agostino_result) {
    output <- capture.output(print(agostino_result))
    
    # Extract the line with the skew, z, and p-value information
    result_line <- grep("^skew", output, value = TRUE)
    
    # Split the result line to remove the part after "p-value"
    result_parts <- strsplit(result_line, "alternative hypothesis: ")[[1]]
    formatted_result <- result_parts[1]
    cat(formatted_result, "\n\n")
}

# Custom function to format the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test results for pretty printing
format_ks <- function(ks_result) {
  output <- capture.output(print(ks_result))
  
  # Extract the lines that have the "D =" and "p-value =" information
  relevant_lines <- output[grepl("^D =", output) | grepl("^p-value", output)]
  
  cat(paste(relevant_lines, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
}

# Custom function to format the polynomial regression summary for pretty printing
simplify_poly_sum <- function(summary_output) {
  
  # Extracting R-squared and Adjusted R-squared
  r_squared <- summary_output$r.squared
  adj_r_squared <- summary_output$adj.r.squared
  
  # Extracting the F-statistic and its p-value
  fstatistic <- summary_output$fstatistic
  f_value <- fstatistic["value"]
  p_value <- pf(f_value, fstatistic["numdf"], fstatistic["dendf"], lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # Creating the formatted output string
  formatted_output <- paste(
    sprintf("R-squared: %.2f", r_squared), 
    "\n\n\n",
    sprintf("Adjusted R-squared: %.2f", adj_r_squared),
    "\n\n\n",
    sprintf("F-statistic: %.2f on %d and %d DF \n\n\n p-value: %.2f", 
            f_value, 
            fstatistic["numdf"], 
            fstatistic["dendf"], 
            p_value),
    "\n\n"
  )
  return(formatted_output)
}

coef_poly_sum <- function(summary_output){

  # Extracting the coefficients table
  coefs <- summary_output$coefficients
  
  if (nrow(coefs) == 3){
    rownames(coefs) <- c("Intercept", "$x$", "$x^2$")
  } else if (nrow(coefs) == 4) {
    rownames(coefs) <- c("Intercept", "$x$", "$x^2$", "$x^3$")
  }
  
  coefs <- round(coefs, digits = 2)
  coefs <- kable(coefs, format = "markdown", align = "l", position = "left")
  
  return(coefs)
}
